about.intro: At KL Servis Rumah, we believe that home maintenance should be straightforward, premium, and stress-free. We provide a high standard of painting, ceiling repair, plumbing, waterproofing, and handyman services across Kuala Lumpur & Selangor with insured operations and background-verified tradesmen.
about.missionBody: Historically, the Malaysian home services market has been fragmented, with homeowners struggling against unreliable independent contractors, sudden price inflation, and messy cleanups. We built KL Servis Rumah on structured, premium, and transparent delivery guidelines. We aim to elevate local home care by guaranteeing itemized fixed pricing, using superior SIRIM-certified materials, and deploying background-checked specialists who clean up entirely after themselves.

team.title: Highly Skilled Local Tradesmen
team.desc: We do not hire raw, unverified contract laborers. Every builder, painter, and plumber is background-checked and highly trained.

warranty.title: Ironclad Warranties
warranty.desc: We stand firmly behind our work. If any joint leaks or ceiling sags within our warranty period, we fix it free of charge.

materials.desc: From SIRIM-certified pipes to premium paints and molly toggle wall anchors, we select only industrial-grade supplies.

cleanliness.desc: We mask borders and lay down thick plastic drop sheets to guarantee that we leave your property as spotless as we found it.

pricingPage.quoteFactorsTitle: What usually changes the price on site?

quoteFactors.0: Measured size, quantity or total work area
quoteFactors.1: Existing wall, pipe, board or waterproofing condition
quoteFactors.2: Material grade, brand and safety requirements
quoteFactors.3: Condo access rules, lift protection or restricted timing
quoteFactors.4: Emergency response, after-hours or same-day urgency
quoteFactors.5: Bundled work that reduces separate visit charges

whatsappBox.title: Send photos on WhatsApp
whatsappBox.body: Share your area, measurements, photos and timing. Our team will guide you toward the right service and confirm the likely market-rate budget before dispatch.

0.q: How do you set your prices?
0.a: We follow standard Klang Valley market rates. Prices are not inflated and not underpriced. Final quotes are confirmed only after scope, access, materials and urgency are checked.

1.q: Do you charge hidden fees later?
1.a: No. If extra work is needed, it is explained first and approved by you before we continue.

2.q: Can I get a quote from photos on WhatsApp?
2.a: Yes. Many small jobs can be estimated from clear photos, measurements and your area. More complex leak, ceiling or exterior jobs may still need an inspection.

3.a: Emergency jobs can cost more when urgent dispatch, after-hours labour, access difficulty or safety controls are involved. The emergency uplift is explained before work starts.

content.needHelp: Need help applying this to your property?
content.needHelpDesc: Send your photos, area, and preferred timing. Our dispatch desk will help identify the suitable service and quote at standard market rate.
content.guidanceIntro: Malaysian homes face tropical humidity, fast rain cycles, condo management rules, and mixed construction materials. That means the right method depends on surface condition, access, safety requirements, and whether water or structural movement is involved.
content.guidanceSafeApproach: The safest approach is to shortlist the likely cause, collect clear photos, confirm the property type, and request an itemized market-rate quotation. KL Servis Rumah confirms scope before work begins and avoids arbitrary pricing.
